mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(REQUST_NO AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1 AS "rqesterNo" FROM COMTHPROGRMCHANGEDTLS

SELECT PROGRM_FILE_NM AS "progrmFileNm" , REQUST_NO AS "rqesterNo" , RQESTER_ID AS "rqesterPersonId" , CHANGE_REQUST_CN AS "changerqesterCn" , REQUST_PROCESS_CN AS "rqesterProcessCn" , OPETR_ID AS "opetrId" , TRIM(PROCESS_STTUS_CODE) AS "processSttus" , TO_CHAR(PROCESS_DE, 'YY-MM-DD') AS processDe , TO_CHAR(REQUST_DE, 'YY-MM-DD') AS rqesterDe , REQUST_SJ AS "rqesterSj" FROM COMTHPROGRMCHANGEDTLS WHERE PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{params.progrmFileNm} AND REQUST_NO = #{params.rqesterNo}
